commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Alejandro Quintero has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+7' Sebastian Boselli (Getafe) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom left corner. His promising effort is kept out by Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+4' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Vitor Reis (Girona) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Alex Moreno and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
90+2' Martin Satriano (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+1' Joel Roca (Girona) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Alejandro Quintero pulls out a yellow card.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Fran Beltran (Girona) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
87' Fran Beltran (Girona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

83' Mario Martin (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

82' Joel Roca (Girona) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went in the direction of the middle of the target and the goalkeeper pulled off a save to deny him.

80' What was Alex Moreno (Girona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

68' Daley Blind (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Alex Moreno (Girona) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!

66' Alex Moreno (Girona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
